title: Holloway Theatre: The Missing Violin
description: A priceless violin has vanished from the dressing-room safe during intermission. Three people remained in the theatre. Examine the stage, question the company, and let the evidence name a suspect.

truth.summary: Vera, pressed by gambling debts, slipped the spare safe key from her programme, entered the dressing room during intermission, and took the violin around 20:40. The undamaged safe, her debts, and Nell's sighting converge on her. Otto's rosin prints are a red herring: he crossed the stage hauling crates, then lied about it fearing blame. Kit spent the intermission mending curtains in the workshop, needle never still.
timeline: 20:25 - Otto hauls crates across the stage in his work boots.
20:28 - Kit settles in the workshop with the torn curtain panel.
20:35 - Nell leaves the stage for the foyer.
20:40 - Vera opens the dressing-room safe with the spare key. The call bell rings.
20:42 - Nell passes the dressing room and sees Vera inside.
